title: CD300ld on neutrophils is required for tumour-driven immune suppression
model: Cas9 mouse haematopoietic progenitors transplanted in vivo, 355-gene myeloid transmembrane knockout library, B16-F10 tumours
contrast: Tumour-infiltrating vs bone-marrow CD45+ cells (1 vs 1, no replicates)
paper_calls: No gene at FDR 0.10; Cd300ld ranked first (FDR 0.069) and followed up
barcs_calls: 1 gene at FDR 0.10 (Cd300ld), screening-level; no control guides for calibration or a control null
verdict: Both methods single out Cd300ld as the only standout gene, and BARCS calls it at FDR 0.006. The screen has one library per tissue and no controls, so the call is screening-level.
